spells.name: Proximate
spells.targeting: All proximate spells target the spellcaster themselves.

spells.name: Healing
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Restore X Health (max 3).

spells.name: Focus
spells.text: [icon: free-action symbol]: Gain X Blessed counters.

spells.name: Strength
spells.text: [icon: free-action symbol]: Gain +X [icon: Might stat symbol] until the end of the round.

spells.name: Speed
spells.text: Use during a Move to move an additional X+1 squares.

spells.name: Harden Skin
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Gain +X [icon: Defence stat symbol] until the end of the round.

spells.name: Recover
spells.text: [icon: free-action symbol]: May be used when Fatigued to remove a Fatigued counter. [icon: spell-action symbol]: Remove a Poisoned counter.

spells.name: Malacyte Shield
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Increase your Warded value by X (max 1).

spells.name: Insight
spells.text: [icon: free-action symbol]: Add X automatic hits to your Persuade rolls until the end of the round.

spells.name: Hyper Awareness
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Place a Reminder counter on your Adventurer and become Blessed. At any time, including midway through an enemy's Move, discard the Reminder counter to take an action. Remove the Reminder counter in the Assessment Phase if not used.

spells.name: Jump
spells.text: [icon: free-action symbol]: Move your character X+1 squares away, counting each square horizontally and vertically.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Gain the listed effects until the end of the round. X=1: You cannot be targeted by enemies beyond short range. X=2: You cannot be targeted by non-adjacent enemies. You do not block LoS. X=3+: You cannot be targeted. You ignore attacks of opportunity but may still make them. You do not block LoS. You only block movement if you choose to.

spells.name: Malacyte Aura
spells.text: Passive: This character's level 1-3 proximate spells may affect adjacent friendly characters. Effects may be freely split between the caster and other characters. This character may also use their magical armour to negate hits on adjacent friends.

spells.name: Advanced Healing
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Apply these effects in any combination up to X times: Restore 1 Health (max 3). Restore 1 Skill peg (max 1). Remove a status counter.

spells.name: Levitation
spells.text: Use during a Move to ignore terrain or characters (including ignoring attacks of opportunity) of up to X inches in height.

spells.name: Alter Appearance
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Temporarily distort your features to resemble any other character of the same size (e.g. a Lamentor; an Adventurer from another party). Other characters in play will treat you as that character type for all purposes, and will give permission to your character where required (e.g. to move through them or to take an item from them). Characters with a higher rank than the caster ignore these effects. Place X Reminder counters on your character board. Remove one counter in each Assessment Phase. The effects last until the last counter is removed.

spells.name: Phasing
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol][icon: spell-action symbol]: Make a Move of up to X squares, freely moving through walls and terrain and ignoring attacks of opportunity. Must end the Move in an empty square.

spells.name: Foresight
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Look at the top X cards of the Event Deck. Place them back in any order, but turn them 90° to mark which ones you have seen. When any of these rotated cards is resolved, you may spend a Magic peg to re-roll any randomised effect such as an Entry Point or chosen Adventurer.

spells.name: Rearrange Cells
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Temporarily mutate your body into that of a beast. Increase the following statistics by a total of X+2 in any combination: [icon: Might stat symbol] (max 4), [icon: Defence stat symbol] (max 3), [icon: Speed stat symbol] (max 2). Instead of increasing a statistic, you may add any of [icon: hammer weapon-trait symbol]/[icon: bleeding-blade weapon-trait symbol, likely 'Sharp']/[icon: double chevron weapon-trait symbol]/[icon: green segmented weapon-trait symbol, possibly 'Poison']/[icon: red diagonal-slashes weapon-trait symbol, likely 'Vicious'] to your attacks. Make a note of these increases. Increase your size by 1, or increase it by 2 and become [icon: red-and-white eye symbol] if X is 3 or more. While mutated you cannot use any equipment, although you can still carry it. Place X Reminder counters on your character board. Remove one counter in each Assessment Phase. The effects last until the last counter is removed.

spells.name: Vicarious
spells.targeting: Vicarious spells can target any character, friend or foe, in medium range and LoS other than the caster themselves. Cover has no effect. As the spells directly target the victim, the victim may resist them if applicable.

spells.name: Bless
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Target gains X Blessed counters.

spells.name: Protect
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Target gains +X [icon: Defence stat symbol] until the end of the round.

spells.name: Calm
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Target removes a Terrified counter.

spells.name: Fortitude
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Target may ignore any status counters that would be applied until the end of the round.

spells.name: Deflection
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Target increases their Warded value by X (max 1) until the end of the round.

spells.name: Clouded Minds
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Place X Reminder counters on eligible targets. If a target would act outside their turn (e.g. Attacks of Opportunity, Parry, Shield Block, Reaction Skills, etc) they must discard a counter instead of acting. The counters are removed in the Assessment Phase.

spells.name: Strengthen
spells.text: [icon: free-action symbol]: Target removes X Fatigued counters.

spells.name: Healing Hands
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Target restores X Health (max 3).

spells.name: Nausea
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Target is Poisoned.

spells.name: Enchantment
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Target is Moved up to X squares following all normal movement rules.

spells.name: Illusion
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Place an Illusion in any empty square in range and LoS of both the caster and a chosen enemy. The enemy is distracted (see Illusions).

spells.name: Malacyte Sensitivity
spells.text: Passive: This character's vicarious spells may target characters in short range without LoS.

spells.name: Stun
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Target suffers X Fatigued counters.

spells.name: Blood Boil
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Target suffers an attack with 1 die and [icon: shield-with-red-slash weapon-trait symbol, likely 'ignores Warded'].

spells.name: Rouse
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Target removes a Stunned counter.

spells.name: Remote Resistance
spells.text: Passive: This character may resist any spells cast within short range of themselves, using their own pegs, regardless of the target.

spells.name: Advanced Illusion
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Place up to X Illusions in empty squares in range and LoS. All enemies within range and LoS of both the caster and an Illusion are distracted (see Illusions). For resistance purposes, this spell is considered to be cast with one peg. [icon: free-action symbol]: Move an Illusion as if it were a character, ignoring attacks of opportunity.

spells.name: Advanced Enchantment
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Target takes up to X actions (max 3) under your control.

spells.name: Elemental
spells.targeting: Elemental spells can target any square or item in medium range and LoS. Cover applies to ranged attacks as normal, but otherwise has no effect. Any spell that resolves as a ranged attack may be used at any time outside a character's turn that they could use such an attack, such as the Ambush Skill. While elemental spells sometimes resolve as ranged attacks against a character, the target of the spell is the object or energy used against that character, not the character themselves, so Elemental spells cannot be resisted.

spells.name: Telekinesis
spells.text: [icon: free-action symbol]: Choose one: Move a loose item, an item in a friendly character's inventory, or a random item inside an unlocked terrain piece (whichever one you draw first) up to X+2 squares. Traps drawn are triggered against a single target in contact with the terrain piece, if any, and then discarded. If the item reaches a friendly character place it in their inventory. If the item is a weapon and it reaches an enemy, treat it as having been thrown at them. Spread a fire – choose a source of fire and add a Burning counter to any character or terrain piece within X+2 squares of it.

spells.name: Open Door
spells.text: [icon: free-action symbol]: Open or close an unlocked door. [icon: spell-action symbol]: Lock or unlock a door or terrain piece.

spells.name: Focused Energy
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Make a ranged attack with X dice, [icon: hammer weapon-trait symbol] and [icon: bleeding-blade weapon-trait symbol, likely 'Sharp'].

spells.name: Extinguish
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Remove a Burning counter, Torch (even from another character's inventory) or Brazier.

spells.name: Detect
spells.text: Use during a General Search action to take X additional items (max. 3) from the pouch. Traps are resolved immediately. Any other additional items are scattered from the caster.

spells.name: Refract
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Place or flip a Darkness or Light counter and add X Reminder counters. Remove one Reminder counter in each Assessment Phase. Once the last is removed, return the room to its previous state.

spells.name: Push
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Move an item, character, or portable terrain piece up to X squares directly away from you, with no attacks of opportunity. You must spend at least as many pegs as a character/object's size to move it. If a character is moved more squares than they have actions they are knocked prone.

spells.name: Barricade
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Create a barricade of your choice. Alternatively, mark up to X squares of a pit with Reminder counters. These squares are considered solid ground. When all squares of a pit are marked, remove it. If a pit is removed while a character is inside, they are defeated and Left for Dead.

spells.name: Advanced Detect
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Look inside a Searchable terrain piece that fills up to X squares. You may discard an additional Magic peg to remove one Trap found.

spells.name: Advanced Telekinesis
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Choose one: Move any terrain piece you could normally move (see page 60) up to X+2 squares. If it reaches a character, stop moving and treat it as a Knockback with X+2 dice. Move an item in an enemy's inventory up to X+2 squares. They may spend a Skill peg to scatter the item instead. Otherwise, if the item reaches a friendly character place it in their inventory. If the item is a weapon and it reaches an enemy, treat it as having been thrown at them.

spells.name: Weaken Armour
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Reduce an enemy's [icon: Defence stat symbol] by X until the end of the round.

spells.name: Malacyte Perception
spells.text: Passive: This character's elemental spells may target objects in short range without LoS.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Requires a source of fire within range of the caster and the target. Make a ranged attack from the source of fire with X dice, Blast and [icon: flame symbol, Burning].

spells.name: Torrent
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: All targets must be in short range and LoS of a source of water. Choose one: Remove X Burning counters, torches or sconces. Knock X characters prone. Choose a character and roll X dice. Each hit scored Fatigues the target. If the character becomes Stunned, any remaining hits are treated as an attack with [icon: shield-with-red-slash weapon-trait symbol, likely 'ignores Warded'].

spells.name: Cocoon
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Gain the benefits of a Rest action, regardless of enemies in the room or in short range and LoS (enemies engaged with a Resting character will still prevent it as normal). Nearby characters may Rest as part of the spell – it affects up to X characters (including the caster) with a range of X squares.

spells.name: Energy Burst
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Move characters or portable terrain pieces with a total size up to X up to X squares directly away from you, with no attacks of opportunity. Characters are knocked prone.

spells.name: Rebuild
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol][icon: spell-action symbol]: Choose a wall of up to X squares in length. Detach it and reconnect it anywhere else within short range. This cannot cause any room to become inaccessible from the rest of the gaming area.

spells.name: Portal
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Place a Portal in an empty square.

spells.name: Forbidden
spells.targeting: Forbidden spells have a variety of targets, from the caster themselves to other characters to locations. This is usually clear from the spell's text. All targets must be in medium range, and cover has no effect. If spells directly target a victim, they may be resisted as normal. Spells marked * are Elemental in nature and may not be resisted.

spells.name: Sanguine Speed
spells.text: Use during a Move to move an additional X squares. Apply this bonus to all other Move actions made by this character until the end of the round, at no additional cost.

spells.name: Sanguine Power
spells.text: Use during a melee attack to roll X additional dice.

spells.name: Sanguine Sight
spells.text: [icon: free-action symbol]: Gain Night Sight [icon: crescent moon with eye, Night Sight symbol]. Place X Reminder counters on this character's Dashboard. Remove a Reminder counter at the end of each round. These effects last until the last is removed.

spells.name: Otherworldly Affinity
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Target an Otherworldly [icon: Otherworldly symbol, circle-in-circle] character in range of up to rank X. Mark it with X Reminder counters. While the counters are in place, it is considered to be your Companion for all purposes and may act in the current round. Remove one Reminder counter in each Assessment Phase.

spells.name: Hellfire Portal*
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Target suffers an attack with 1 die, Burning [icon: flame symbol] and Vicious [icon: red diagonal-slashes weapon-trait symbol]. [icon: free-action symbol]: Create an Arcane Torch [icon: Arcane Torch item card].

spells.name: Hail of Malacytes*
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: All other characters (friend or foe) in short range suffer a ranged attack with X dice and Sharp [icon: bleeding-blade weapon-trait symbol].

spells.name: Curse
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Target is Cursed.

spells.name: Cardiac Strike
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Target suffers an attack with X dice and [icon: shield-with-red-slash weapon-trait symbol, likely 'ignores Warded'].

spells.name: Psionic Strike
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Target suffers an attack with X dice. No damage is caused. Instead, for each hit the target loses a Magic peg. On a critical hit, the target loses one Skill peg as well. For each peg the target is unable to lose, they become Fatigued.

spells.name: Spectral Shroud
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Place a Darkness counter and X Reminder counters on your Dashboard. While these are in place all enemies consider everywhere within short range of this character to be in the dark. This is cancelled out by light sources as normal. Friendly characters are unaffected. Remove a Reminder counter in each Assessment Phase. When the last is removed, remove the Darkness counter too.

spells.name: Raise Dead
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Place a Revenant [icon: Revenant character-type symbol] character of up to rank X (max 3) at the nearest empty Grave Point (or at a point scattered from the caster if Grave Points are not being used). Mark it with a Reminder counter. Treat the marked Revenant as if it were summoned, but it does not leave a Dimensional Portal when removed.

spells.name: Dimensional Portal
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Place a Dimensional Portal in a target square. Dimensional Portals work like regular Portals with the following additions: They may be placed in a square containing another character. That character enters the Portal immediately. They are a summoning point for the Summoning spell. A character forced to emerge randomly following a Mental Overload result changes all of their Health pegs to black ones and loses control. Otherworldly [icon: Otherworldly symbol, circle-in-circle] characters ignore this rule.

spells.name: Power Dispersal
spells.text: Passive: After this character becomes Corrupted, roll a combat die for each other character (friend or foe, with a dashboard) in short range, if any. If any hits are rolled, they gain one Magic peg. On a critical hit, they also gain one Health or Skill peg (owning player's choice). On a [icon: skull symbol, Mental Overload result] the character becomes Fatigued. On a blank there is no effect.

spells.name: Leech
spells.text: Passive: All of this character's attacks, magical or otherwise, gain [icon: white ribcage symbol]/[icon: purple star symbol]/[icon: teal star symbol] against targets within short range.

spells.name: Corrupt
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Target becomes Corrupted. If this causes them to lose control, you may control them until the end of the round. From the next round onwards they follow the normal rules.

spells.name: Summoning
spells.text: [icon: spell-action symbol]: Choose an Otherworldly [icon: Otherworldly symbol, circle-in-circle] character from those not being used for this game of up to rank X. Place it adjacent to a summoning point in range. You may spend one additional peg (within normal rank limits) to use the Elite side of the character's board, if applicable.

spells.name: Sanguine Blast*
spells.text: Use during a melee attack. Instead of resolving the attack as normal, instead resolve an attack with X dice, Blast, and Bludgeoning from the caster's position. All characters hit are pushed one square away from the caster, if possible, and are knocked prone. The caster is unaffected.

spells.name: Conjuration
spells.text: [icon: free-action symbol]: Gain a common item of your choice with buy value up to [icon: currency symbol]4X. [icon: spell-action symbol]: Gain an uncommon item of your choice with buy value up to [icon: currency symbol]4X. [icon: spell-action symbol][icon: spell-action symbol]: Gain a rare item of your choice with buy value up to [icon: currency symbol]4X.

levels.text:
Make a Move action with [icon: dice showing 2 and 3].

Passive: You may Stand Up as an effortless action.

Reaction: Use when targeted with an attack. Roll three combat dice. Each hit scored negates one hit from the enemy's attack. If no hits remain, all other effects of the attack are ignored.

Passive: You may treat Rough Ground [icon: Rough Ground X] values as one lower.

You burst out of combat. All enemies engaged with your character may be pushed up to two squares away in a direction of your choice, stopping if they hit a wall or other obstruction. No attacks of opportunity are made, but each enemy pushed back suffers an attack with 2 dice. Then, you may make a Move action.

You sweep your enemy's feet from under them. An enemy in contact is knocked prone.

Passive: This character's attacks gain Quickstrike [icon: Quickstrike]. If using a weapon that also has Quickstrike [icon: Quickstrike], you may Dash AND Attack.

Reaction: Use when an enemy engages you, before they attack. Their attack has no effect. Swap positions with the enemy, and then make a Move action with no attacks of opportunity or a Knock Back action with +1 die.

Jump from a higher level, increasing your safe distance by 3. All characters of the same size or smaller adjacent to your landing position are knocked prone. Then make a Melee Attack with additional dice equal to the distance of the Jump.
Make a Move action.
Passive: Gain Fast 1 [icon: Fast].

Make a Move action. This and all your other Move actions in this turn ignore attacks of opportunity. Make an attack with one die against each enemy contacted during your Moves. Any hits will also knock them prone, even if no damage is caused.

Reaction: Use when an enemy engages you. Make a Move action, ignoring attacks of opportunity.

Passive: Ignore one hit scored against you during any attack of opportunity.

Reaction: Use when an enemy engages you. In any order, make a Move action, ignoring attacks of opportunity, and an Attack action.

Passive: This character may use Parry [icon: Parry] against ranged attacks.

Reaction: Use when an enemy engages you. The attacker is Stunned. In any order, make two Move actions, ignoring attacks of opportunity, and an Attack action.

Passive: You may use an effortless action to ignore an attack of opportunity.
A character in medium range and LoS becomes Fatigued.
Make a Ranged Attack action or Throw an item. The target or another enemy within short range of the target suffers two Fatigued counters in addition to damage caused, if any. Then make a Move action.

You may make a Move action with a character in medium range and LoS (you cannot use this Move to engage an enemy or do anything that could cause the character direct harm), and they suffer two Fatigued counters. You may make a Move and an Attack action yourself, in any order, before or after moving the target.

Reaction: Use after suffering a melee attack in which you took no damage. Take any item from the attacker's inventory other than the one they attacked with. If you do not have space for it, drop it or another item you are holding.

Move into contact with another character and make a Pickpocket action.

Pickpocket: When in contact with another character, roll a combat die:
- [icon: skull, miss]: You fail. There is no effect.
- Blank: One of the target's items, chosen at random, is scattered.
- [icon: single hit]: Take a non-large item of your choice from the target's inventory.
- [icon: double hit / critical]: Take an item of your choice from the target's inventory and knock them prone.
- The target may spend a Skill peg to avoid this effect.

Then make another Move action, with no attacks of opportunity.
Passive: You have access to the Pickpocket action as standard.
Use before making a Persuade roll. Add two automatic hits to the roll.

Make a Persuade action against an Adventurer from another party to try to dissuade them from their mission. They suffer one Fatigued counter per unblocked hit.

Passive: Add one extra die to your Persuade rolls.
Make a Persuade action against any character, adding three automatic hits. The normal options apply, except that Adventurers from other parties will not join you.
You may lock or unlock a door or terrain piece in contact, OR you may use when Searching, after drawing tokens, to ignore any Trap token(s) drawn with no effect.

Reaction: Use when a trap card or token is drawn targeting this character or a friendly character within short range and LoS. This character spots and disables the trap's trigger. Discard the card/token with no effect.

Passive: You may make a General Search as an effortless action.

Use when Searching (terrain or General) to draw one additional token from the pouch and one random uncommon item. Do not resolve any traps drawn – they should either be returned to the pouch or left inside a Searched terrain piece.

Passive: Your attacks gain [icon: Poison].
Reaction: Use whenever you would suffer a status counter of any type. Discard the counter with no effect.
Gain +2 [icon: armour/shield] until the end of the round.

Restore 1 Health. This may take you above your starting level as long as there is space on your dashboard. You may discard any status counters you wish to.

In addition, you ignore all damage, resist all spells without spending pegs, and discard all status counters with no effect until the end of the round.
Reaction: Use after scoring one or more hits on an enemy in melee. Make another Melee Attack action.
Reaction: Use after scoring one or more hits on an enemy with any attack. Move if you wish, and then make another Melee Attack action.
Use during a Move action. You may ignore attacks of opportunity during this Move, and you may make a melee attack against each enemy you engaged with while moving.
Restore 1 Health.
Use before activating to remove any Stunned, Poisoned or Wounded counters.

Reaction: Use after being defeated. You are no longer defeated – restore 1 Health and Stand Up.

Passive: At the start of your turn you may remove one Fatigued counter.
You cannot be Stunned, Knocked Back or laid prone until the end of the round.

You cannot Move this turn, but you gain one extra die on all attacks and Knock Backs until the end of the round.

Passive: You may ignore the Cumbersome [icon: Cumbersome] rule in any turn in which you do not Move.

Until the end of the round:
- You cannot become Fatigued, Stunned, Knocked Back or laid prone.
- Enemies cannot move out of contact unless you allow them to.
- After any melee attack made against you, you may make a free Knock Back action against the attacker.
- If an enemy moves within two squares, you may make a free Dash to engage them, becoming their target if you weren't already.
Use Purification 1 [icon: water drop, Purification] - replace your rightmost black Health peg with a green one.

Cast any spell at any level, whether you have access to it or not, ignoring rank and peg limits. Spend actions as normal. This spell uses the Forbidden Magic die even if the user is not Unsanctioned [icon: Unsanctioned]. After resolving the spell, become Corrupted for each level that the spell is higher than your rank.

Passive: All of your spells that involve rolling for an attack gain Vicious [icon: Vicious].

You draw on the powers of an otherworldly being to perform acts beyond your physical limitations. Resolve the effects of any Skill at any level. Then become Corrupted.

This Skill can be used with reaction Skills at the appropriate time. It can only be used during a quest - it does not apply in the Campaign Phases.
Use before casting a [icon: spell, lightning bolt] spell to cast it while engaged.

Reaction: Use when a friendly character in short range suffers an attack. Use this character's magical armour to negate hits. Magic pegs from any combination of this character and the target character may be used to boost the armour. Any Magic Die effects are applied to this character.

Until the end of the round, all spells targeting friendly characters in short range are automatically resisted without spending pegs, unless an Unstoppable result is rolled. All attacks against friendly characters in short range can be negated using this character's magical armour, spending any combination of this character and the target characters' Magic pegs to boost the armour. Any Magic Die effects are applied to this character.

Passive: When casting spells of a level lower than your own rank, you do not become Fatigued when you suffer a Mental Overload result.
Cast any non-Forbidden level 1 spell, whether you have access to it or not, spending an action or effortless action as normal.
Reaction: Use after rolling the Magic Die to roll it again and pick which of the two results to apply.

Reaction: After rolling an Unstoppable result during your turn, immediately cast any [icon: spell, lightning bolt] or [icon: spell, checkmark] spell you have access to at a casting value of 2, without spending any pegs. Instead of rolling the Magic Die you may choose which die result you want to apply to this spell. Then take any action for free.

Passive: Gain Regeneration 1 [icon: Regeneration] [icon: Magic peg] - restore 1 Magic peg in the Assessment Phase.
Reaction: Use at any time. Cast any [icon: spell, lightning bolt] or [icon: spell, checkmark] spell you have access to.
Passive: You may spend any number of Skill pegs when casting a spell to increase its casting value by the number of pegs spent. This can exceed your rank.

You force a huge burst of energy through one of your magical items. Choose a weapon you hold with the Channel [icon: Channel] icon, and decide how many Magic pegs you will spend (minimum 1). Make a ranged attack at short range using a number of dice equal to the pegs spent +3 (this includes the +1 for the Passive effect below). Any icons on the chosen weapon are applied to the attack. Mental Overload results on the Magic Die are ignored with no effect.

Passive: When you use an item with the Channel [icon: Channel] icon, resolve the effects as if one additional peg had been spent.
Make a Melee action using only your [icon: melee weapon stat] with one extra combat die. If the target survives lay it prone.

Choose a character you are engaged with that is no larger than you and throw them. Move them into any square within short range and LoS. They suffer no attacks of opportunity from this move. They suffer an attack equal to your [icon: melee weapon stat]+1, rolling an additional die if a wall or other terrain piece prevented them being thrown the full distance. Then lay them prone. If their trajectory was blocked by a character, that character also suffers an attack equal to your [icon: melee weapon stat]+1.

Passive: You may ignore the Cumbersome [icon: Cumbersome] rule for melee weapons.
Make up to three Melee actions using only your [icon: melee weapon stat]+1. If the target survives lay it prone. Then make a Move action.
Reaction: Use after suffering a melee attack in which you took no damage. The weapon that the attacker used is removed from their dashboard and scattered.

Reaction: Use after suffering a melee attack in which you took no damage. The weapon that the attacker used is removed from their dashboard and added to yours. If you do not have space for it, drop it or another item you are holding.
Reaction: As level 2. In addition, you may make an immediate Melee Attack action with the stolen weapon, followed by a Move action with no attacks of opportunity allowed.
Use before making a melee attack. Add two dice to the attack.
Use before making a melee attack. Add three dice to the attack.

Use before making a melee attack. Add four dice to the attack. After rolling the dice, you may split the hits scored between any number of enemies in range of your weapon. Any other effects such as Bludgeoning are applied to all enemies that suffer a hit.

Passive: Gain First Strike [icon: First Strike].

Make a Melee Attack with a weapon. You may re-roll one die.

Passive: You may use the Shield Block [icon: Shield Block] ability as an effortless action. You still become Fatigued if it is used outside your turn.

Use after making a melee attack with a weapon. The target is Wounded and Stunned.

Passive: You may make a Melee Attack as an effortless action.

Use after rolling for a melee attack with a weapon. You may roll again for a different weapon in your inventory, combining hits and effects. [icon: skull, miss] results apply to each weapon separately. Then make a Knock Back action with +1 die, or a Move action ignoring attacks of opportunity.

Passive: When making melee attacks, [icon: critical hit] results on the blue die are critical hits.
Make a Ranged Attack at short range. This attack does not roll any dice – it scores 1 automatic hit, ignoring cover.

Make a Ranged Attack at up to medium range. This attack does not roll any dice – it scores 1 automatic hit, ignoring cover and physical armour.

Passive: This character's ranged attacks ignore cover at short range.

Make a Ranged Attack at up to medium range. This attack does not roll any dice – it scores 2 automatic hits, ignoring cover and physical armour.

Passive: This character's ranged attacks ignore cover at medium range.
Reaction: Use after being targeted with a ranged attack or spell, before the attack is resolved. Make a Ranged Attack or cast a spell against the attacker.
Reaction: Use at any time after a target enemy has taken its first action in the current round. Make a Ranged Attack or cast a spell against the target.
Reaction: Use at any time. Make a Ranged Attack or cast a spell against an enemy with one extra combat die (if applicable), and then make a Move action.

Use when making a melee attack to use a ranged weapon instead. Roll to hit as normal using the weapon's short-range statistic and add one die to the attack.

Passive: You may ready a ranged weapon with Preparation [icon: Preparation] as an effortless action.

Throw any melee weapon, rolling two additional dice, OR throw any other item as if it was a weapon, rolling two dice.

Passive: You may make a Ranged Attack as an effortless action.

Make a Ranged Attack with a Shot [icon: Shot weapon] weapon. Ignore the Unreliable [icon: Unreliable] rule and add the Bludgeoning [icon: Bludgeoning], Sharp [icon: Sharp] and Piercing [icon: Piercing] rules to the attack.

Passive: When making ranged or thrown attacks, [icon: critical hit] results on the blue die are critical hits
Make a Ranged Attack. You may re-roll one die.

You shoot an item from an enemy's hand. Make a Ranged Attack. If at least one hit is scored, no damage is done, but an item of your choice is removed from their inventory and moved up to six squares in a direction of your choice.

Make a Ranged Attack with three extra combat dice. After rolling the dice, you can split the hits scored between any number of eligible targets within range of your weapon and within short range of each other.
Reaction: Use when an enemy ends a move within 4 squares and you are in full or partial cover. Make a Ranged Attack action against that enemy. You may Dash before or after this action.

Reaction: Use when an enemy ends a move within 4 squares and you are in full or partial cover. Make a Move action and then an Attack action against that enemy. You may Dash once before or after either of these actions.

Reaction: Use when an enemy ends a move within 4 squares and you are in full or partial cover. Make a Move action, an Attack action against any enemy, and then another Move action. You may Dash once before or after any of these actions.

While you are in contact with any wall you cannot be targeted for the rest of the round. Enemies can move through adjacent squares without stopping or attracting attacks of opportunity from you and cannot end a move in contact with you. You do not block LoS in any way.

Make a Move or Ranged Attack action. While you are in contact with any terrain you cannot be targeted for the rest of the round. Enemies can move through adjacent squares without stopping or attracting attacks of opportunity from you and cannot end a move in contact with you. You do not block LoS in any way.

While you are not in contact with an enemy you cannot be targeted for the rest of the round. Enemies can move through adjacent squares without stopping or attracting attacks of opportunity from you and cannot end a move in contact with you. You do not block LoS in any way.

Passive Reaction: At any time (including midway through an enemy's Move) during a round in which you are camouflaged using this Skill you may make a Ranged Attack action and then become Fatigued.
Reaction: Use after being targeted with a ranged attack or spell if you are within 4 squares of cover. Move into cover.
Reaction: Use after being targeted with a ranged attack or spell if you are within 4 squares of cover. Move into cover and ignore all effects of that attack.

Reaction: Use at any time. Make a Move action into cover ignoring attacks of opportunity, and make an Attack action, in any order. You cannot be targeted for the rest of the round as long as you do not move from your position.
While in cover, you cannot be affected by ranged attacks until the end of the round, although you can be targeted as normal.
While in cover or at more than short range, you cannot be affected by ranged attacks until the end of the round, although you can be targeted as normal.
Make a Move action ignoring attacks of opportunity. You cannot be affected by any enemy ranged attacks until the end of the round, although you can be targeted as normal.

Market Phase: You may perform one of the following:
- Purchase an item of any value, in addition to the normal limits.
- Draw an additional rare item from the supply – this will now be available to purchase.
- Sell one item for its buy value, to a maximum of [icon: currency]10 x your rank.

Market Phase: Deduct up to [icon: currency]2 from the buy prices or add [icon: currency]2 to the sale prices of up to three items, in any combination.

Passive: Deduct up to [icon: currency]2 from the cost of one item or Adventurer upkeep cost in each Market Phase.
Market Phase: Increase the number of [icon: currency] gained from any quest objectives (if applicable) by 50%, rounding up.
Remove a Terrified counter from a friendly character in short range.

Reaction: Use after defeating an enemy. All other friendly characters in short range may remove a Terrified counter OR take one action.

Passive: Any other friendly character that starts its turn in short range and LoS of this character removes a Terrified counter before activating.
All friendly characters in short range (including this one) remove all Terrified and Fatigued counters. Each may then make one action.
Reaction: Use when an enemy in LoS activates. You may choose the enemy's target for the round from any eligible characters it can see, even if it is already engaged and/or another target is closer.

Reaction: Use when an enemy enters LoS or starts their turn within LoS. Their turn immediately ends and they are Stunned.

Passive: As an effortless action, you may take an action with any friendly character in short range. They then become Fatigued.

All enemies of this character's rank or lower within short range and LoS are Stunned and Terrified.

Passive: You gain Terrifying [icon: Terrifying].
Use after taking an action. Another Adventurer in your party within short range and LoS immediately makes the same action for free, if able.

Advancement Phase: Add one Experience to any other Adventurer in your party. This Experience may only be assigned to Agility, Endurance, Melee, Ranged or Stealth Skills.

The trainee's rank may be no higher than X.
Advancement Phase: Add one Experience to any two Adventurers in your party. One can be at any rank; for the other the trainee's rank may be no higher than X.
Use when Resting. You and any other friendly characters that Rest this round restore an additional Health peg and an additional Magic peg.
You or a friendly character in contact removes a Wounded or Poisoned counter and restores one Health.
You and all friendly characters in contact are Blessed, and may each take an additional action this round.

Use during a General Search action to forage, taking the items listed below in addition to any drawn. Roll the Magic Die.
- 1: You did not find anything other than the item drawn.
- 2-3: Take a Morsel or Herbs* token. [icon: Morsel/Herbs tokens]
- 4-5: Take a Provisions or Fungus* token. [icon: Provisions/Fungus tokens]
- 6: Take a Remedy or Minerals* token. [icon: Remedy/Minerals tokens]

Passive: When staying in the Wilderness in the Rest Phase you may roll once on the above table for each character with this Skill.
At the start of your turn, choose a non-Otherworldly [icon: Otherworldly] Wandering Beast within medium range and LoS. You may use any of your actions this turn to control the Beast instead.

Select a random non-Otherworldly [icon: Otherworldly] Wandering Beast of rank 1-3 (see page 44). It enters play at an Entry Point of your choice and will be controlled by you in the Adventurer Phase for the rest of the game. It may activate this round.

Passive: Non-Otherworldly [icon: Otherworldly] Wandering Beasts will never target you.
Reaction: Use at any time. Take an action.
Passive: Use at any time, once per round. Take an action and then become Fatigued.
Reaction: Use at any time, including midway through an enemy's Move. You may take up to two actions and an effortless action.
Look at the top three cards of the Event Deck.

Based on the current Dread, roll for the arrival of all NPCs due to arrive this round and place them next to the appropriate Entry Points. Grave Points or any other arrival location within short range of this Adventurer cannot be used. You may then move the NPCs at any one Entry Point to a different one. Their arrival will not be rolled again this round – they will just be activated and enter the gaming area as normal.

Passive: If any rule causes your Staging Point to be swapped with a random Entry Point, you may roll the Magic Die twice and pick your preferred result.

Reaction: Use either before or after an enemy enters LoS/is placed onto the gaming area, interrupting their Move if necessary. This character may take a free turn immediately. All friendly characters within short range may take one action. Any of these actions that target the arriving enemy gain one extra die. If the arriving character survives any attacks they may take/continue their turn as normal.

Passive: You may treat Rough Ground [icon: Rough Ground X] values as two lower.

Rest Phase: After any Raucous Night result, gain X additional Renown.

Passive: Whenever Renown would be spent, this character may spend their Skill pegs instead of the party's Renown, following the usual restrictions on Skill use.
Reaction: Use whenever Renown is gained by your party. Gain one additional Renown.

Remove a Fatigue counter from another character in short range.

Rest Phase: Add up to 2 to any Inn roll without spending Renown.

Use when Resting. Bless each friendly character (including this one) in short range. You may increase the Dread level by up to two to Bless each character that many additional times.

Rest Phase: At the end of the Phase, Bless all characters in your party.

This character inspires all around them to draw upon their inner strength to perform great feats. Place three Reminder counters on this character's board. While these are in place, all friendly characters in short range may use their Magic pegs as if they were Skill pegs. Remove one Reminder counter in each Assessment Phase.

Passive: This character may use Magic pegs as if they were Skill pegs.

Reaction: When an attack is made by a friendly character in short range, add the Poison [icon: Poison] rule to the attack. If it already has the Poisoned rule, add Vicious [icon: Vicious] instead.

Passive: Apply the benefits of a Herbs, Fungus or Minerals token as a regular action, instead of during a Rest.

During a quest, spend two actions in the same round to Craft a potion token (those marked [icon: potion] on the back) as if you were visiting the Artisan's Guild at no cost. You may craft items requiring any number of [icon: resource H], [icon: resource F], and [icon: resource M] resources, and up to a total of X other resources.

Market Phase: Craft an item as above at no cost.

You brew a potion ([icon: potion]) with whatever you have at hand. Draw three crafted potion tokens at random and choose one to keep at no cost. Mark the potion with the pen.

After the potion is used, roll a combat die. For each hit scored, the user gains their choice of a Health, Magic or Skill peg. On a [icon: skull, miss] the user is Poisoned.

Advancement Phase: Add one Experience to any other Adventurer in your party. This Experience may only be assigned to Townsfolk, Cunning, Magic, Support or Survival Skills, or to Spells.

The trainee's rank may be no higher than X.

Use when Searching (terrain or General) to draw X additional tokens from the pouch. If any of these additional tokens is a Hidden Location or a Rare item, you may choose one to take in addition to whatever else was found. Otherwise the additional tokens are returned to the pouch with no effect.

Use before setting up a quest to add an additional random rare item to the token pouch.

Passive – Market Phase: You may re-roll the die when resolving a Book [icon: book].

During a quest, spend an action to Repair a broken item as if you were visiting the Artisan's Guild at no cost. The items you may repair depend on X:
1. Common
2. Common or Uncommon
3. Any Item

Market Phase: Repair an item as above at no cost.

During a quest, spend two actions in the same round to Craft a weapon or armour token as if you were visiting the Artisan's Guild at no cost. You may craft items requiring any number of [icon: resource S], [icon: resource W], [icon: resource T] and [icon: resource R] resources, and up to a total of X other resources. At least one peg must be spent.

Market Phase: Craft an item as above at no cost.
Spend an action to create a Barricade in an adjacent square.

Reaction: Teamwork! When this character or another friendly character within short range and LoS makes an attack, for each friendly character in contact with themselves or the target of the attack they may either add one die to the roll or gain Vicious [icon: Vicious]. A maximum of X dice and/or effects can be added.

Reaction: We Trained for This! Use after an Event Card is drawn but before it is resolved; or use after rolling for the arrival of one or more characters at an Entry Point in LoS.

This character and all others within short range may take one action for free. They may become Fatigued to take a second action. Then continue the game, resolving the interrupted effects.

Passive: During a friendly character's turn, between actions, another unactivated character may become Fatigued to take an action. Both characters must be in short range of the character with this Skill.

Use when in a room containing no enemies. You may close any doors in that room and flip any Entry Point markers within short range of a character in that room. You may reposition any characters in that room. Then, for each friendly character in the room, replace the uppermost peg in the Dread Tracker with a green one.

Green pegs do not count towards the current Dread. When a peg is to be added to the tracker, replace the lowest green peg instead. While any green pegs remain, the flipped Entry Points must be re-rolled for arrival purposes. When the last green peg is replaced, flip the Entry Points back.

This character makes use of their seemingly mundane talents for the good of the party. In the campaign phases between games, this character may spend up to X pegs. For each peg spent:
- Escape Phase: Adjust a Left for Dead roll for this Adventurer by 1.
- Advancement Phase: Add one Experience to any Adventurer in your party (max 1 per Phase, Adventurer's rank may be no higher than X).
- Market Phase: Ignore the Upkeep for an Adventurer.
- Rest Phase: Re-roll any result at the Inn or in the Wilderness.

Passive: This character is never targeted by enemies unless they are the only target in LoS.
Passive: This character may spend the party's Renown as if it were their own Skill pegs.

Reaction: This character seems to be exceptionally lucky and unlucky at the same time. Use after rolling an attack for or against this character. If this character is attacking, the attack causes one additional damage regardless of the roll, and is considered to have rolled a critical hit. If this character is being attacked, ignore all effects of the attack and Stun the attacker.

Then draw and resolve an Event Card.

abilities.name: +X dice
abilities.text: This is usually found alongside the Channel [icon: Channel symbol] icon. The attack may roll an additional number of dice equal to the number of pegs spent.

abilities.name: Ammunition
abilities.text: A character firing a weapon with this icon must have a Gear or Armour token of the matching type to fire it. However, Throwing Stars are a weapon in themselves – they do not require a separate Gear token and the Weapon token itself is discarded if they run out.

abilities.name: Balanced
abilities.text: This weapon rolls +1 dice when thrown.

abilities.name: Bludgeoning
abilities.text: If this attack rolls a critical hit, the target is Fatigued, even if no damage was caused. The target suffers one additional Fatigued counter for each damage caused. This attack rolls one extra die when attacking terrain pieces.

abilities.name: Book
abilities.text:
In the next Market Phase after obtaining this item, roll the Magic Die to see what literary secrets you've uncovered. If the token is Uncommon, add 1 to the roll. If the token is Rare or Exclusive, add 2 to the roll.

- 1-2: The book is worthless – discard it.
- 3-5: The book is sold for [icon: currency/coin symbol] equal to the number rolled.
- 6-7: An Adventurer of your choice gains 1 Experience. Discard the book.
- 8: You find information on an ancient artefact. Add one random relic resource [icon: relic resource symbol] token to the token pouch and discard the book.

abilities.name: Burning
abilities.text:
If this attack rolls a critical hit, the target is Burning, even if no damage was caused.

Equipment with this icon is considered a source of fire.

abilities.name: Camouflage
abilities.text: This character can only be targeted by ranged attacks from within short range.

abilities.name: Channel
abilities.text:
This icon will be seen alongside other statistics or abilities. At least one Magic peg must be spent to use the statistic/activate the ability. If an ability has an X value, additional pegs may be spent to improve the effect.

Abilities with the black Forbidden Channel icon work in the same way, but the Forbidden Magic Die must be rolled instead of the regular Magic Die.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.text: If a melee attack with this weapon defeats an enemy, you may resolve the same attack against another eligible enemy, removing one hit from the roll. You may continue to do this until you fail to defeat an enemy or there are no eligible enemies remaining.

abilities.name: Crafting – Resource
abilities.text: This item is used as an ingredient for crafting – see page 84. The letter and colour determine the resource type. Numbered items are used to craft unique relics.

abilities.name: Creature
abilities.text: Unless stated otherwise, this character cannot Open Doors, Search, use equipment or Interact with terrain.

abilities.name: Cumbersome
abilities.text:
If an attack with this weapon rolls any [icon: skull] and is not broken, turn the token 180°. It cannot be used in this position. It requires an effortless action to ready the weapon for use again.

Cumbersome weapons cannot be thrown.

abilities.name: Curse
abilities.text: If this weapon rolls a critical hit, the target is Cursed, even if no damage was caused.

abilities.name: Darkness/Light
abilities.text:
Treat this item as the appropriate counter. It will move with any character carrying it, affecting the area in short range as usual.

If the item is discarded when it resolves, place the counter in the room instead.

abilities.name: Defensive Re-roll
abilities.text: The character may force a single die to be re-rolled from any attack made against them, unless the attack ignores physical armour. Critical hits cannot be re-rolled.

abilities.name: Discard
abilities.text: When this item has been used, return it to the supply.

abilities.name: Effortless
abilities.text: This item can be used as an effortless action.

abilities.name: Entangling
abilities.text: If this attack causes one or more hits, the target is Fatigued. If this attack rolls a critical hit, the target is knocked prone. These effects apply even if no damage was caused.

abilities.name: Fast
abilities.text: When making a Move action, this character can move X additional squares. If a character has this ability from multiple sources, they use the highest value – they do not stack.

abilities.name: First Strike
abilities.text: When this character enters within melee range of an enemy (including when placed onto the gaming area or when a door opens), it gets an immediate free Melee Attack action.

abilities.name: Fly
abilities.text:
This character can fly above the ground with the following benefits:

- Scramble [icon: Scramble symbol with X value]
- They ignore the first hit of any attack of opportunity against them.
- They cannot be knocked prone. They are still subject to any other parts of a rule that would normally make them prone.

abilities.name: Hawkeye
abilities.text: This attack ignores partial cover and can fire at engaged characters at any range without randomising the target.

abilities.name: Hazardous
abilities.text: When this item would be used, roll the blue die. If a hit is scored, the item's normal effects are applied. On a blunder, the user suffers the effects shown alongside the Hazardous icon instead (such as gaining status counters or losing pegs). On a blank, no effects are applied.

abilities.name: Hidden Location
abilities.text: Draw the Hidden Location card with the number matching this token. Return the token to its supply (the pouch for common tokens, or the separate bag otherwise).

abilities.name: Hit and Run
abilities.text: After making a melee attack, if this character is still engaged it will make a free Move directly away from the defender, ignoring attacks of opportunity, if there is space to do so. It will not engage other enemies with this Move.

abilities.name: Immobile
abilities.text: This character cannot Move or be moved unless a rule explicitly says otherwise.

abilities.name: Immunity
abilities.text: This icon will be seen alongside other abilities and statuses. This character does not suffer any counters or effects from the ability shown.

abilities.name: Indestructible
abilities.text: This item ignores any rule that would cause it to break. If you need to determine a random item to be broken, choose another if possible.

abilities.name: Infinite Ammo
abilities.text: When this token is used for a ranged attack, it ignores [icon: skull] results that would cause you to run out of ammunition and discard it.

abilities.name: Key
abilities.text: A character carrying this item may lock or unlock any door or terrain piece as an effortless action.

abilities.name: Lasting Effect
abilities.text:
Effects granted by this item last until the end of the round. Rotate the token 180° as a reminder. If the token is discarded after use, place it on your character board instead and discard it at the end of the round.

The user may spend X Magic pegs (max 2) to add X Reminder counters to the item. In each Assessment Phase, remove a Reminder counter instead of discarding/rotating the item.

abilities.name: Location-Specific
abilities.text: Unless stated otherwise in a quest briefing, this item only works in the quest in which it was found, or the next quest if purchased in a Market Phase.

abilities.name: Loud
abilities.text: Increase the Dread by 1 when this item is used.

abilities.name: Lull
abilities.text: Reduce the Dread by the amount shown when this item is used.

abilities.name: Magical Armour
abilities.text:
Spend an action and up to X Magic pegs to increase your Warded value by the number of pegs spent.

Rotate the token 180° to mark it as active. The token cannot be used in this position.

abilities.name: Malacyte Enhancement
abilities.text: This character may cast spells with one more Magic peg than their rank allows.

abilities.name: Malacyte Stability
abilities.text: You may discard a Magic peg to re-roll the Magic Die.

abilities.name: Malacytic Conduit
abilities.text: This character cannot contain the magical energy in their body. At the start of each of this character's turns, add a blue peg to the Dread Tracker. If on an item, the rule applies while it is being carried or worn.

abilities.name: Master
abilities.text: This icon will be seen alongside other abilities on Companions or Summoned characters. The linked ability applies to the controlling character while they are within short range of this character.

abilities.name: Night Sight
abilities.text: This character ignores all effects of Darkness (see page 61).

abilities.name: Otherworldly
abilities.text: This character originates from another dimension. The icon (found on character boards and any associated [icon: Event Card symbol] Event Cards) has no effect on its own but will interact with other rules found in Maladum expansions.

abilities.name: Pack
abilities.text: These characters arrive in groups. When they enter play, place the number of miniatures shown here instead of a single character. They still activate individually.

abilities.name: Parry
abilities.text: When the user of this item is the target of a melee attack, you may roll a combat die. Each hit scored will negate one hit from the enemy's attack as if it were physical armour. You then become Fatigued.

abilities.name: Piercing
abilities.text: Physical armour cannot negate hits from this weapon.

abilities.name: Plunderer
abilities.text: If this attack causes damage, a random item from the defending character's inventory is scattered. If the attack also scored a critical hit the attacker may take the item instead.

abilities.name: Poison
abilities.text: If this weapon rolls a critical hit, the target is Poisoned, even if no damage was caused.

abilities.name: Preparation
abilities.text: After this weapon is used, turn the token 180°. It cannot be used in this position. It requires an action to ready the weapon for use again.

abilities.name: Purification
abilities.text:
When this ability is used, the character may replace their X rightmost black Health pegs with green ones.

This ability will specify when it applies, such as when Channelled, when Resting, or by spending an action or Skill.

abilities.name: Quickstrike
abilities.text: If this weapon rolls a critical hit during a melee attack, you may Dash or make another attack (with this or any other weapon) for free immediately after the initial attack is resolved.

abilities.name: Rank
abilities.text: The power level of an NPC. NPCs activate in order of rank, starting with the highest, and their rank may also be referenced by other rules and effects.

abilities.name: Reach
abilities.text:
This weapon may be used to make a Melee Attack against an enemy up to X squares away, including diagonally. Unless in contact, the characters are not considered to be engaged for any other purpose, including attacks of opportunity.

When using multi-level terrain this rule applies vertically as well – the marks on the ruler can be used to determine how many squares a target is from their attacker when measuring up or down at an angle. Measure from ground level.

NPCs with this rule will make Attack actions as soon as their weapon is in range of their target – they will not Move closer if they do not need to. Characters with First Strike [icon: First Strike symbol] may also choose to stop and attack once they are within their weapon's range.

abilities.name: Reactive
abilities.text: Once per turn, if another character starts their turn or enters a square within range of this character's attacks (intentionally or otherwise), this character immediately makes a free attack against them. This interrupts any movement, and the moving character can continue their action/turn after the attack if they survive.

abilities.name: Regeneration (peg type)
abilities.text: Restore X pegs of the type shown in the Assessment Phase. If a character has this ability from multiple sources, they are cumulative.

abilities.name: Relentless
abilities.text:
A character attacked multiple times in a single round by characters with this rule will have their physical armour reduced by 1 for each attack after the first, to a minimum of zero.

For example, the first attack by a character with Relentless will use the defender's standard armour value. The second will reduce it by 1; the third will reduce it by 2, and so on.

abilities.name: Re-roll
abilities.text:
If on a weapon, the character may re-roll a single combat die each time the weapon is used to attack or parry.

If on a character board or any other type of token, for each roll made, the character may re-roll a single die of any type used for any action or effect on their behalf.

abilities.name: Rest
abilities.text: This icon will be seen alongside other abilities and is only used during a Rest action. This character may discard the token to apply the abilities shown.

abilities.name: Restoration
abilities.text: These icons are found on potions and other remedies. When used they restore X pegs or grant X additional actions (based on the icon shown) to the user or another Adventurer in contact. Actions must be used in the character's turn in the current round.

abilities.name: Retaliation
abilities.text: If this item/character blocks at least one hit from a melee attack that rolls any [icon: skull], resolve an attack against the attacker with one die for each [icon: skull] rolled.

abilities.name: Rope
abilities.text:
This character may spend an action to place this token in contact with them. While the token is in position, any character may Climb up or down from that location at a cost of one action for each level (height of a wall) climbed.

If placed in contact with a gap, characters may Jump across the gap from its location, adding 2 to their safe distance.

abilities.name: Rough Ground
abilities.text: This area follows the rules for Rough Ground on page 58, using the value shown. Characters or items may have this icon with a negative value, reducing the effect of any area of Rough Ground they are in accordingly.

abilities.name: Scramble
abilities.text:
The top number is the maximum height or width in squares/inches of objects/characters that the character can move up or over as part of a normal Move action – they do not need to Climb them or spend any actions, just like a regular character climbing stairs.

The bottom number is the character's safe distance for Jumping down or across.

abilities.name: Sharp
abilities.text: If this weapon rolls a critical hit the target is Wounded, even if no damage was caused.

abilities.name: Shield Block
abilities.text:
This character may spend an action to raise the shield, taking this token from their inventory and placing it on their miniature to gain the effects shown inside the shield icon. The token is placed back into the inventory again as soon as the user does any of the following:

- Takes any action other than Move or Dash.
- Suffers damage.
- Becomes Stunned.

The character may also raise the shield when the character is attacked outside of their own turn, before dice are rolled. After the attack the character will become Fatigued.

Only one Shield can be raised at a time.

abilities.name: Size
abilities.text: This character is smaller or larger than an average human and additional rules apply, most commonly used for LoS (page 10), Knock Backs (page 29) and Moving Objects (page 60).

abilities.name: Skill
abilities.text: The Skill shown here can be used by the character at up to the level shown, exactly as if they were on the character's Class board.

abilities.name: Stash
abilities.text: This item may be instantly discarded when found to add its value to your Stash – it does not have to be placed into an Adventurer's inventory.

abilities.name: Terrifying
abilities.text:
If this character rolls a critical hit when attacking, the target is Terrified.

If an enemy character ends their turn within short range of this character, roll the Magic Die. On a 1 that character becomes Terrified.

abilities.name: Trap
abilities.text:
This item is a trap that can be set by an Adventurer. They may make an Interact action to set it and place it in an adjacent square.

NPCs are unaware of the trap and will not adjust their route to avoid it. The trap is triggered immediately when an enemy enters a square containing or adjacent to it and its effects are resolved against that enemy. Then flip the token face down – it will not resolve again this round. Flip it face up again in the Assessment Phase. Each time the trap is resolved, roll a die. On a [icon: skull], discard the token.

Adventurers may pick the item up.

abilities.name: Unarmed Combat
abilities.text: This value will be found on a character's board (including their armour slot). They may use this value to make melee attacks even if they do not have a weapon.

abilities.name: Unreliable
abilities.text: If an attack with this weapon rolls a single [icon: skull], it has jammed. Turn the token 180°. It cannot be used in this position. It requires an action to ready the weapon for use again. If it rolls two or more [icon: skull] it has broken.

abilities.name: Unsanctioned
abilities.text: This character follows the rules for Unsanctioned Maladaar on page 39.

abilities.name: Vampiric (peg type)
abilities.text: If this attack rolls a critical hit the target loses a peg of the type shown if possible, in addition to any damage caused. If multiple types are listed, the target loses whichever they have the most of (attacker's choice if equal). If a peg was lost, the attacker restores a peg of same type if possible. If they cannot, they become Blessed if possible.

abilities.name: Vicious
abilities.text: [icon: blue-die blank/burst result symbol] results on the blue die on attacks made with this weapon are critical hits.

abilities.name: Volatile
abilities.text: If this attack rolls a [icon: skull] on the blue die, the user takes one damage. Then, all adjacent characters suffer an attack with a number of dice matching the original attack and the Burning [icon: flame] rule.

abilities.name: Worthy Opponent
abilities.text:
If an Adventurer defeats this character, their party gains one Renown. The character must be defeated with a direct attack or effect – death from delayed effects such as being Poisoned or Wounded do not grant Renown.

This character can only appear once per quest. Once it has arrived, any further rules that cause another to enter play are ignored, even after it has been defeated.

itemLore.name: Potions
itemLore.text:
[NOTE: This entry begins a distinct 'Item Notes' section on page 156 (file icons-158.png), not the alphabetical icon glossary proper.] Some equipment requires more specific rules than can be covered by the standard icons and statistics. These items will be marked [icon: exclamation mark] – if you see this on an item you should check the rulebook for full details.

POTIONS: Some rules refer to "Potions". These are all items marked [icon: potion bottle symbol] on the back.

itemLore.name: Healing Knowledge
itemLore.text: This is not an equipment token. When granted to an Adventurer this is placed into either side of the armour slot on their character board, and is treated as part of their board for all purposes.

itemLore.name: Adamantine Elixir
itemLore.text: While in effect, this potion grants Immunity to the following effects: Bludgeoning, Burning, Entangling, Poison, Sharp, Terrifying, as well as increasing the user's physical armour by 2. This armour increase does not hinder magic use.

itemLore.name: Blessed Water
itemLore.text: This item can only be used to attack Revenants.

itemLore.name: Camping Gear
itemLore.text: The party may re-roll all Wilderness rolls in the rest phase.

itemLore.name: Cordial of Cognisance
itemLore.text:
When this item is used, the character gains three Experience and may immediately assign it to their Class Board. Skills and Spells chosen may be used this round. We suggest marking the gains in a different colour as they are temporary.

When the token is discarded the character loses two of the gained Experience and Skills/Spells.

Note that characters only Level Up in the Advancement Phase.

itemLore.name: Daemon Mantle
itemLore.text: This item may be used to cast the Rearrange Cells spell with X = 5. No pegs are spent and the Magic Die is not rolled. Rotate the token 180° - it cannot be used for the rest of the game.

itemLore.name: Doorbuster
itemLore.text: This item adds three dice to a character's unarmed combat value against terrain pieces only.

itemLore.name: Gas Trap
itemLore.text: This is resolved as a Ranged Attack with Blast against the character that triggered it. It does not cause damage. Instead each target suffers one Fatigue counter per hit.

itemLore.name: Maladaar's Almanac
itemLore.text:
Characters must have a spell track on their Class board to use this item. The user marks spaces on it equal to their rank (marking a new space when they reach a new rank). For each space marked, the user may learn a new spell as if XP had been spent. Mark these with an X on the Maladaar reference card.

If after any quest a different character carries this item, erase any filled spaces here and erase the corresponding spaces on the character's reference card.

itemLore.name: Mystic Grimoire
itemLore.text: The character holding this item may learn spells one level higher than their rank. Learned spells are retained if the character no longer holds the item.

itemLore.name: Oblivion's Echo
itemLore.text: This device channels the Crucible of Resurrection. The user may Interact with the item as if they were Interacting with a Crucible. All the same rules apply. See page 53.

itemLore.name: Sceptre of Dominion
itemLore.text: The character with this item can Persuade any character to do anything (except Adventurers from other parties will not join you). NPCs with no Persuade value use their rank instead.

itemLore.name: Sledge of Burden
itemLore.text: This character is considered to be one size larger for the purposes of moving objects.

itemLore.name: Tome of Revenance
itemLore.text: This item allows the user to re-roll attacks and effects against Revenants only.
